title: mespilus oxyacantha subvar. glabrata
intro: Mespilus oxyacantha subvar. glabrata, commonly known as the wild service tree or glabrous service tree, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mespilus oxyacantha subvar. glabrata include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve gut health, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
